text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest overnight gains in the 1-3% range, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation into altcoin strength despite Bitcoin's elevated dominance at 59.2%. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 69 (Greed territory) but has declined 5 points over the week, indicating sentiment remains constructive yet cooling from recent peaks. Total 24-hour volume of $78B is moderate, reflecting steady but not exceptional trading conviction across the market.
